patthana16.81:1.1: bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana16.81:2.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho na na bhāvanāya pahatābbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. anidassana appaṭighaṃ savitakka
